description:
Zinnias are cheerful, colorful flowers that are a popular choice for gardens and bouquets. They are considered non-toxic and safe for cats. This means that if a curious cat decides to nibble on a zinnia leaf or petal, it is not expected to cause any illness or toxic reaction.

Because they pose no known threat, zinnias are an excellent, worry-free option for cat owners who want to add some bright color to their home or garden. You can enjoy these beautiful flowers without being concerned about your cat's safety around them.
name: Zinnia
